_comment: Tracker for upstream PRs this setup depends on or cares about. Each entry: id (owner/repo#number), title, repo, branch, url, state (open|merged|closed|superseded), merge_state (from `gh pr view --json mergeStateStatus`), last_checked (UTC date), backs (plugin ids in plugins.json this PR enables; empty for quality-of-life PRs), notes, reapply (actionable snippet to restore the diff locally after `hermes update` drops it). CI lint verifies: valid JSON, every plugins.json tracked_by_prs[].id exists here, allowed state, and backs referencing real plugin ids. Refresh with: bash scripts/prs-refresh.sh

prs.title: feat(plugins): add transform_footer lifecycle hook
prs.notes: transform_footer render hook (plugin appends a block to the final gateway reply). REWRITTEN on 2026-10-22 against current main instead of a 35k-commit rebase: the August branch targeted gateway/run.py, which has since split into gateway/run_turn.py + run_turn_persistence.py. Call site is now GatewayTurnMixin._hmwa_compose_footer (runtime footer + _hmwa_plugin_footer_line), so the streaming trailing-send path carries both, and a plugin block renders even when display.runtime_footer is off. Suppressed on finite (-z, chat -q) turns. MERGEABLE, marked ready for review (was draft), BLOCKED only on maintainer review. 42 focused tests + hooks.md catalog row. Needed by the quota plugin.
prs.reapply: gh pr diff 85060 -R NousResearch/hermes-agent | git -C "$HERMES_CORE" apply --3way
